name: human-internal-writing
description: Turn source-faithful viewpoints into restrained, credible, actionable internal long-form writing.

interface.shortDescription: Write source-faithful internal long-form without generic AI phrasing.
interface.longDescription: Transform meeting notes, interviews, leadership viewpoints, and rough drafts into restrained internal articles with traceable claims, a distinctive human voice, and concrete action. Includes an explainable editorial checker. Kuaishou-internal users can optionally retrieve authorized meeting sources from OnePoint; the general writing method does not depend on it.
defaultPrompt: Turn these meeting notes into a restrained internal article.
Preserve my viewpoint while removing generic AI phrasing.
Cold-read this team letter and strengthen its action path.
